_comment: Credential authority classification for #1186. The live product CRUD path and runtime credential selection must use their canonical owners; retired implementations are recorded here so a deleted surface cannot quietly return.

canonical.scope: request principal user id for product CRUD; authorized binding scope for runtime selection

reachable.storage: Fernet-encrypted UserCredentialStore; values never enter responses

reachable.scope: authenticated user id passed to every store operation

reachable.storage: runtime pool records; no product credential storage
delegates credential values to the canonical provider boundary

reachable.scope: user id plus workspace and connection scope
reachable.storage: Fernet-encrypted JSON with canonical master-key rotation

reachable.authority: SPEC-011 deployment secret vault, separate from product CRUD
reachable.scope: deployment/admin trust boundary; never a per-user credential store

retired.reason: The v2 PostgREST service exposed id-only reads, secret reads, updates, and deletes without a principal predicate. It had no production callers and is deleted rather than made into a second credential authority.
